policy.git_scope: explicit whitelist; data/ and results/ remain ignored by default and only listed release assets are force-tracked
policy.self_trained_weights: commit directly when below the GitHub single-blob limit
policy.large_derived_databases: commit canonical tables/manifests/builders; rebuild matrices deterministically or from fixed model inputs
policy.large_third_party_weights: do not vendor; pin upstream source/version/checksum and restore separately

rebuildable_assets.note: Combines the official released CLIPZyme screening asset with the tracked native-extension embeddings in frozen general-candidate order.
